scenarios.title: A static page at the loopback origin renders WebGL2 under SwiftShader
scenarios.asserts: heading and probe canvas visible; a WebGL2 clear reads back rgba(0, 128, 255, 255)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M0. Harness precondition of V02: the e2e tier can render WebGL2 without a GPU (e2e/specs/harness/webgl-and-firewall.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: A request to a host outside the allowlist is aborted and reported
scenarios.asserts: fetch of a Firestore URL fails in the page; the firewall fixture records the URL and the console guard the blocked load
scenarios.notes: Milestone M0. Proves the firewall fixture (e2e/support/network.ts) that every later spec relies on to keep real Mapbox and Google off the network; since M1 Mapbox hosts are answered by the mock APIs, so the probe uses Firestore, which nothing may reach.

scenarios.title: Mapbox GL from the mock APIs draws a mapbox:// tileset and an XYZ layer in the middle slot
scenarios.asserts: pixel probes read the basemap background, then each layer's solid colour; both rasters in the middle slot; 1 map created, 1 map.load event; style, TileJSON, glyphs and tiles answered 200
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. The mock APIs (e2e/mock-apis/) behind Mapbox GL JS 3.32.0, driven directly on a spec-made page (e2e/specs/harness/mock-apis.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: A Mapbox path the mock does not implement answers 404 and is recorded
scenarios.asserts: the page's fetch gets 404; GET /__calls lists the path with status 404; the console guard records the failed load
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. An API the engine starts to use without a mock fails loudly instead of reaching the network.

scenarios.title: Compare in the Layers panel creates the second map only then and splits the map at the divider
scenarios.asserts: Compare in the Layers panel -> the map-instance counter counts one new map, only now; the divider at 50 %: left of it the main side's layer (pixel probe), right of it today's basemap; dragging the handle to 70 % moves the boundary; the hash holds cmp= and sw=70; hcm-compare-change says {open, swipe, null, 0.7}
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §3; owner: compare). e2e/specs/viewer/compare.spec.ts; the engine's session and driver in packages/engine/test/compare/session.test.ts, the surface in packages/ui/test/viewer/compare/hcm-compare.test.ts.

scenarios.title: On a compact window compare is a toggle, and the second map is hidden, not made again
scenarios.asserts: at 360 px Compare offers a two-way toggle (the main side | the compared side) on the one map: the counter stays at one map, the toggle swaps the pixels, sw is 0 for the compared side; widening to 1280 px creates the second map; narrowing again hides it (created 2, removed 0), widening again shows the same map with no new map load, and Close then destroys it (removed 1); a minute compact destroys it too (the engine test)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §3; owner: compare). e2e/specs/viewer/compare.spec.ts; the engine's session and driver in packages/engine/test/compare/session.test.ts, the surface in packages/ui/test/viewer/compare/hcm-compare.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Leaving compare destroys the second map

scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §3; owner: compare). e2e/specs/viewer/compare.spec.ts; the engine's session and driver in packages/engine/test/compare/session.test.ts, the surface in packages/ui/test/viewer/compare/hcm-compare.test.ts.

scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §5.7; owner: export). Test: e2e/specs/starter-kit/export.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Accepting analytics in an export loads nothing
scenarios.asserts: a city published with a GA4 id: the export's city.json carries no analytics ids, so no consent banner asks, no Firebase SDK loads and no GA4 or crash-report request leaves
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §5.1, §5.7; owner: export). Test: e2e/specs/starter-kit/export.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: An export opened by double-click says the map could not load
scenarios.asserts: index.html opened from file:// -> the engine runs but city.json cannot be fetched -> error.manifest.network with Retry; the README's first step says to serve the folder
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §5.7; owner: export). Test: e2e/specs/starter-kit/export.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: One command scaffolds a city that boots
scenarios.asserts: create-historic-city cluj --yes --name-ro Cluj --bbox 23.5,46.72,23.7,46.82 writes index.html, city.json and README.md; city.json passes the manifest schema with the name, the bounds and the default seed's theme; the folder served boots against the mock world
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §4.2, §4.3; owner: kit-cli). Test: e2e/specs/starter-kit/create-city.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: --dry-run shows everything and changes nothing
scenarios.asserts: the files it would write and the commands and pages of the self-host steps are printed; no file is written, the fake firebase and gcloud record no call and the fake opener opens nothing
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §4.2; owner: kit-cli). Test: e2e/specs/starter-kit/create-city.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: The self-host steps run the owner's own CLIs, one consent each
scenarios.asserts: with fake firebase and gcloud first on PATH and a fake xdg-open: each step asks y/N first; firebase login, projects:create, the billing page opened, billing polled until linked, the admin deployed to Hosting and its Setup opened; no credential is ever asked for or printed With --experimental only (CR-M5-7), whose warning comes first; the sign-in is probed with firebase login:list as plain text, never --json (whose answer holds the account's tokens), and no token reaches the output.
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §4.4; owner: kit-cli). Test: e2e/specs/starter-kit/create-city.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A folder that is not empty is left alone
scenarios.asserts: a target folder with files -> exit 1 with the reason; nothing is written or overwritten
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §4.3; owner: kit-cli). Test: e2e/specs/starter-kit/create-city.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A secret Mapbox token is refused at the prompt
scenarios.asserts: an sk. token typed at the optional token question -> refused with the warning, never written to city.json or echoed; a pk. token is written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §4.3; owner: kit-cli). Test: e2e/specs/starter-kit/create-city.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Without the Firebase CLI the self-host steps stop before running anything
scenarios.asserts: no firebase on PATH -> the pinned install command is printed, nothing runs, exit 1
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §4.4; owner: kit-cli). Test: e2e/specs/starter-kit/create-city.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Billing never linked stops with how to resume
scenarios.asserts: the fake gcloud keeps answering billingEnabled false -> after its polls the CLI stops with the billing page and the resume command, exit 1, nothing deployed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §4.4; owner: kit-cli). Test: e2e/specs/starter-kit/create-city.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Answering no stops at that step
scenarios.asserts: n at project creation -> nothing is created; the remaining steps are printed for later; exit 0
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §4.4; owner: kit-cli). Test: e2e/specs/starter-kit/create-city.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Self-hosting is not available yet without --experimental
scenarios.asserts: self-host and deploy without --experimental -> exit 1 with cli.selfHost.unavailable; no tool runs, no page opens, no server folder is written (a dry run needs no flag)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5, the reviews' fixes (docs/research/DECISIONS-for-review.md §65; owner: the fixer). The UX review's finding 1 (docs/LESSONS.md 239). Test: e2e/specs/starter-kit/create-city.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A taken project id is named with another to try
scenarios.asserts: firebase projects:create failing -> cli.project.failed with <project>-2, a y/N before the console opens; no -> cli.project.notCreated, exit 1, the creation tried once and no page opened
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5, the reviews' fixes (docs/research/DECISIONS-for-review.md §65; owner: the fixer). The UX review's finding 14 (docs/LESSONS.md 240). Test: e2e/specs/starter-kit/create-city.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: The map's colours change from one colour
scenarios.asserts: theme cluj --seed #1b6c4a -> city.json's theme is the seed and its four schemes (themeFromSeed), everything else as it was; the page's theme-color follows; no tool runs
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5, the reviews' fixes (docs/research/DECISIONS-for-review.md §65; owner: the fixer). The UX review's finding 13. Test: e2e/specs/starter-kit/create-city.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A colour that is no colour changes nothing
scenarios.asserts: theme with --seed green -> cli.seed.invalid, exit 1, city.json unchanged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5, the reviews' fixes (docs/research/DECISIONS-for-review.md §65; owner: the fixer). The UX review's finding 13. Test: e2e/specs/starter-kit/create-city.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: The public map opens at the Hosting root and every city at its path
scenarios.asserts: the e2e Hosting tree -> / boots the first city from the public bucket's manifest with one map load and its own meta policy, asking nothing of Firestore or Firebase; /iasi/ (a city made in the admin, no committed site) boots that city through the generic city page with one map; /admin/ serves the admin
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §2.1, §2.4; owner: hosting). Finding 14 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/specs/viewer/hosting.spec.ts (tour states site.city-generic in e2e/tour/site-states.ts).

scenarios.title: A 2015-2022 link through the Pages redirect page opens the same view on Hosting
scenarios.asserts: the Pages redirect tree with the hash 15.5/44.4271/26.0853/90/!a3!p2 -> the Hosting root with the same hash, the same view and photo open; without script the page says the map moved, in Romanian and English
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §2.7; owner: hosting). Finding 14 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/specs/viewer/hosting.spec.ts (with and without JavaScript).

scenarios.title: Before Publish the map the root says the map is being set up
scenarios.asserts: the start-up variant -> / shows the bilingual being-set-up page with a link to the admin, loads no engine and no Mapbox, and release.json says start-up
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §2.5; owner: hosting). Finding 14 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/specs/viewer/hosting.spec.ts (tour state site.start-up).

scenarios.title: A city that is not published, or a path that is no city, is said plainly
scenarios.asserts: /e2e-unpublished/ -> the viewer's map-not-found card with no map load; /Not_A_City/ -> the bilingual 404 page with links to the map and the admin
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §2.2, §2.4; owner: hosting). Finding 14 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/specs/viewer/hosting.spec.ts (tour state site.not-found).

scenarios.title: Google's consent stand-in issues a token that the fake Google APIs honour
scenarios.asserts: a popup of /__oauth/authorize lists the owner preselected and the requested read-only Cloud scope ticked -> Allow posts idToken, accessToken, scope and expiresIn from the mock APIs' origin -> tokeninfo answers the owner, the e2e OAuth client and the granted scopes in the browser's world and in the shared one the Functions emulator reaches; the consent request is recorded as allowed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. Google's OAuth is the only part of Google stood in for in the browser (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §2.6; e2e/admin/harness/consent.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: A cancelled consent tells the app and grants nothing
scenarios.asserts: Cancel on the stand-in page -> the opener receives a cancellation from the mock APIs' origin and no grant; the consent request is recorded as cancelled
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. The admin's stand-in client reads it, or a closed popup, as popup-closed-by-user (e2e/admin/harness/consent.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: The consent grants only the chosen account and the scopes left ticked
scenarios.asserts: another account chosen and one requested scope unticked -> tokeninfo of the issued token names that account and only the scopes left ticked; the request is recorded with them
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. The mechanism behind S-A27-BAD-SCOPE-DENIED and S-A27-BAD-WRONG-ACCOUNT (e2e/admin/harness/consent.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: The admin server serves the e2e build as Hosting does, with the emulators in its CSP
scenarios.asserts: the page holds the admin shell; firebase.json's headers with the CSP minus upgrade-insecure-requests and plus the emulators' and mock APIs' origins in connect-src; a deep link gets the app; /__/firebase/init.json is the demo-hcm web configuration and /runtime.json the e2e runtime; the legacy bundle's 45 records, the originals and the kit's fonts are served
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. e2e/mock-apis/admin-server.ts over scripts/site/src/admin/hosting.ts, whose unit tests prove the CSP is the only header that differs (e2e/admin/harness/world.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: A Google host that no fake answers stays blocked in the admin projects
scenarios.asserts: a fetch of a Firestore URL from the admin's origin fails in the page; the firewall records the URL and the console guard the blocked load
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. The admin projects forward the fake upstreams' hosts only, so the admin never reaches real Firestore or any Google API without a fake (e2e/admin/harness/world.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: A persona's storage state is a Firebase Auth session the Auth emulator accepts
scenarios.asserts: with the admin persona, the admin origin's IndexedDB holds Firebase Auth's user record for that account, and the Auth emulator's accounts:lookup with its ID token answers the same uid and address
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. The signed-in fixtures of the admin tier (owner, invited admin, editor, stranger) are storage states with IndexedDB (e2e/admin/support/session.ts; e2e/admin/harness/world.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: The seeded owner, invitation and admin are what admin.session answers
scenarios.asserts: with mapOwner owner, invited admin and admins editor: admin.session on the Functions emulator answers the owner as admin with role owner and the claim, the invited persona as not an admin with an invitation pending, the editor as admin with role admin and the claim, and the stranger as neither, with the map claimed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. The seeds of the admin tier (setup/owner, invites/{sha256 of the address}, admins/{uid} and the admin claim) match what the callables leave (e2e/admin/support/emulators.ts; e2e/admin/harness/world.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: Without a persona the admin opens signed out
scenarios.asserts: no persona -> no Firebase Auth user record in the admin origin's IndexedDB
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. e2e/admin/harness/world.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A hidden server is unreachable until it is shown again
scenarios.asserts: while hidden, a call of admin-session from the admin's origin fails like an unreachable host (the console line claimed); shown again, the anonymous call is refused 401 by the callable's access rule, which the console guard of the admin tier expects
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. 'Not deployed yet' at the network edge for the bootstrap specs (e2e/admin/support/deployment.ts; e2e/admin/harness/world.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: The fake Cloud Run hands a pipeline run to the stand-in, which writes what the pipeline writes
scenarios.asserts: jobs:run of raster-pipeline -> the stand-in runner takes the lease, records each step, holds at the scripted step until released, then leaves the job and its version awaiting approval with the version's seven files, its automatic pairs (checkpoint RMSE 6.2 m) and its output (zooms 10-16); the job's scratch files are gone and the execution succeeded
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §13; owner: e2e-fakes). The imagery world of the admin tier, before the screens and the backend that use it: e2e/admin/harness/imagery.spec.ts over e2e/admin/support/imagery*.ts, e2e/mock-apis/imagery.ts and the M3 fakes of @hcm/test-support (functions/test/support/upstream-imagery.test.ts).

scenarios.title: A scripted failure, a USGS maintenance, too few pairs and an out-of-memory kill end the run as the pipeline would
scenarios.asserts: a failure at warp -> the job and its version failed with apiError.imagery.unreadableRaster and the execution failed; USGS maintenance -> waiting_usgs (usgs-maintenance) with fetch pending; too few pairs -> awaiting_gcps and the version needs_gcps with apiError.imagery.noMatch and its corner pairs; an out-of-memory kill -> the execution failed with exit 137 and the job left running for the tick
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §13; owner: e2e-fakes). The imagery world of the admin tier, before the screens and the backend that use it: e2e/admin/harness/imagery.spec.ts over e2e/admin/support/imagery*.ts, e2e/mock-apis/imagery.ts and the M3 fakes of @hcm/test-support (functions/test/support/upstream-imagery.test.ts).

scenarios.title: The admin's cancel reaches the run as SIGTERM; without a cancel the job goes back to the queue
scenarios.asserts: cancelRequested then the execution's cancel -> the held run stops, the job and its version are cancelled, the scratch files deleted, the execution cancelled; a cancel without cancelRequested (a task timeout) -> the job queued again with retryAt and its step pending
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §13; owner: e2e-fakes). The imagery world of the admin tier, before the screens and the backend that use it: e2e/admin/harness/imagery.spec.ts over e2e/admin/support/imagery*.ts, e2e/mock-apis/imagery.ts and the M3 fakes of @hcm/test-support (functions/test/support/upstream-imagery.test.ts).

scenarios.title: A tileset the fake MTS published serves its own colour to every page
scenarios.asserts: a source uploaded, a tileset created with the raster recipe and published in the server's world -> from an admin page its TileJSON answers zooms 10-16 and a tile is painted in the tileset's own colour
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §13; owner: e2e-fakes). The imagery world of the admin tier, before the screens and the backend that use it: e2e/admin/harness/imagery.spec.ts over e2e/admin/support/imagery*.ts, e2e/mock-apis/imagery.ts and the M3 fakes of @hcm/test-support (functions/test/support/upstream-imagery.test.ts).

scenarios.title: USGS, STAC, Overpass, OpenStreetMap tiles and Mapbox Satellite stay blocked for every admin page
scenarios.asserts: an admin page that loads a USGS browse image, M2M, the STAC catalogue or its COG, Overpass, an OpenStreetMap tile, the Mapbox Satellite style or a Mapbox Satellite tile -> blocked by the firewall, each address recorded; only servers reach their fakes
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §13; owner: e2e-fakes). The imagery world of the admin tier, before the screens and the backend that use it: e2e/admin/harness/imagery.spec.ts over e2e/admin/support/imagery*.ts, e2e/mock-apis/imagery.ts and the M3 fakes of @hcm/test-support (functions/test/support/upstream-imagery.test.ts).

scenarios.title: The project owner claims the map with Google and reaches the dashboard
scenarios.asserts: verified Google account signs in through the consent stand-in (no Cloud scope) -> admin.session says unclaimed -> the claim panel naming the project -> Confirm with Google (one click, one read-only consent: cloud-platform.read-only) -> admin.claim on the Functions emulator: tokeninfo of the caller's own token, testIamPermissions grants resourcemanager.projects.setIamPolicy on the mock Resource Manager -> admins/{uid} role owner, setup/owner and the admin claim -> the Setup Assistant open at billing; at most 2 inputs and 2 consents; no e-mail address is configured or sent besides the ID token
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); M2b smoke of the admin tier, normal mode (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §1.3, §2.1, §3.3 d2; e2e/admin/specs/smoke.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: A non-admin without an invitation is told and signed out
scenarios.asserts: a verified Google account signed in, the map already claimed, no invitation -> admin.session -> adminShell.auth.notAdmin in the page language with Use another Google account -> signed out: the sign-in button again; no admins document for the account
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); the notAdmin state of docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §1.3, with the stranger's storage state (e2e/admin/specs/smoke.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: Closing the sign-in popup offers Retry
scenarios.asserts: popup closed (sign-in or the claim consent) -> nothing claimed, Retry offered
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: A delayed claim is picked up by a token refresh
scenarios.asserts: admins/{uid} exists but the ID token has no admin claim yet -> admin.session answers refreshToken -> the app refreshes the token once and opens the dashboard
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: A Google account that does not own the project cannot claim it
scenarios.asserts: testIamPermissions grants nothing -> apiError.claim.notOwner naming the project id; no admins document, no claim
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: An access token of another account or app is refused
scenarios.asserts: tokeninfo names another e-mail address or another OAuth client -> apiError.claim.tokenMismatch; Resource Manager is never called with it; the token appears in no log line
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/admin/claim.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A second owner claim is refused once the map has an owner
scenarios.asserts: an owner exists -> apiError.claim.alreadyClaimed for another account (the owner's own repeat claim succeeds unchanged); the first owner keeps the role
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/admin/claim.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An invited Google account joins as admin
scenarios.asserts: admins.invite stores invites/{sha256 of the lowercase address} and returns the admin link -> the invitee signs in with Google -> admin.session shows the pending invitation -> admin.join -> admins/{uid} role admin, admin claim, invitation deleted -> dashboard
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: An invalid email is rejected
scenarios.asserts: invalid address -> the e-mail field refuses it (validation.format, aria-invalid) before any call
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); the page in M2c (owner: ops-screens). admins.invite refuses it too (inviteRequestSchema): functions tests.

scenarios.title: A revoked admin loses access
scenarios.asserts: Remove access on an admin's detail asks first, naming the admin -> admins.revoke -> admins/{uid} deleted, claim removed, sessions revoked -> listed no more; the revoked admin's Save in an open editor is refused by the rules and writes nothing, and the shell, asking admin.session again, says the access was removed (keeping the draft on screen until sign-out: S-A20-BAD-REVOKED-WHILE-EDITING)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.1; owner: ops-screens). e2e/admin/specs/flows/revoke.spec.ts (two browsers: the owner removes the editing admin).

scenarios.title: The owner cannot be revoked
scenarios.asserts: the owner's detail offers no Remove access and says why: the map always keeps its owner
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); the page in M2c (owner: ops-screens). admins.revoke refuses the owner anyway (apiError.revoke.owner): functions tests.

scenarios.title: An admin cannot remove themselves, so the map always keeps an admin
scenarios.asserts: an admin's own detail offers no Remove access and says another admin can; with the owner never revocable the map always keeps at least one admin
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); the page in M2c (owner: ops-screens). admins.revoke refuses oneself anyway (apiError.revoke.self): functions tests.

scenarios.title: An expired invitation cannot be used
scenarios.asserts: the clock passes expiresAt (14 days) -> admin.join answers apiError.invite.expired; no admins document; ops.tick deletes the invitation
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/admin/join.test.ts (admin.join refuses it) and functions/test/ops/accounts.test.ts (ops.tick deletes it).

scenarios.title: Signing in with an address that was not invited does not join
scenarios.asserts: the invitee signs in with another Google account -> admin.session finds no invitation for it -> the not-an-admin panel and sign-out; the invitation stays pending
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: An invitation stores no e-mail address
scenarios.asserts: after admins.invite the invitation document holds role, invitedBy and its times only, and the address is in no Firestore document, response or log line
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/admin/invite.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An invitation is created, copied and cancelled
scenarios.asserts: Invite (a dialog, one Google account address) -> the invitation opens with its expiry and its link, already copied (Copy copies it again; three inputs, CONTENT_INPUT_BUDGETS.inviteAdmin) -> Cancel invitation (asked first) -> admins.revoke for the invitation -> it is gone
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.1; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: Cancelling a revocation keeps the admin
scenarios.asserts: Remove access, then Keep access -> nothing called, the admin still an admin, the focus back on Remove access
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.1; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: The Setup Assistant shows every area with its status and can re-check it
scenarios.asserts: setup.status -> billing, provision, Mapbox, USGS, analytics and crash cards with their state chips and reasons; Re-check runs setup.selfTest and updates each chip; ready once billing, provision, Mapbox and USGS are ok
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: A partial setup opens at the first incomplete step
scenarios.asserts: partial setup/status -> the page opens at the first area that is not ok
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: A failing self-test check names what to fix
scenarios.asserts: the mock Secret Manager refuses access -> the secrets check is invalid with apiError.secrets.unavailable and a link to Provision cloud; every other check still runs and shows its own state
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Since 2026-10-18 (DECISIONS-for-review.md §42b) the page lists every self-test check with its state; e2e/admin/steps/status.spec.ts refuses the secrets in the mock Secret Manager and follows the check's link to Prepare the project.

scenarios.title: setup.status returns health fields only
scenarios.asserts: a setup/status document that also holds an unexpected field -> setup.status answers only the fields of setupStatusViewSchema (the stray field never leaves the function)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/setup/status.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A USGS role still pending is checked again six hours later
scenarios.asserts: setup/status usgs pending with nextCheckAt passed and permissions without download -> ops.tick keeps it pending with the reason apiError.usgs.accessPending, checkedAt now and nextCheckAt six hours later
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/ops/services.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The server check proves that events reach the server
scenarios.asserts: Check again -> the events check writes the probe and ops.onProbe's answer comes back -> ok among the server checks
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.2; owner: server-bugs). Finding 17 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Covered by e2e/admin/steps/status.spec.ts (the Functions emulator delivers ops/probe to ops.onProbe; the probe sent back).

scenarios.title: Events that never arrive are named with the missing role
scenarios.asserts: no answer to the probe within its wait (clock) -> invalid with apiError.setup.eventsUnreached naming roles/run.invoker and Prepare the project
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.2; owner: server-bugs). Finding 17 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Covered by functions/test/setup/self-test.test.ts (the emulators skip IAM, so the refusal is the functions tier's: no delivery within EVENTS_PROBE_WAIT_MS).

scenarios.title: A consent note appears only where its button asks Google

scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §4.2; owner: assists-notify). In e2e/admin/specs/assists/title.spec.ts (state assist.suggestions); the admin side in packages/admin/test/{assist/assist,photos/assists}.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An English draft of the Romanian title fills the field until Save
scenarios.asserts: English draft (offered while only Romanian has text) -> the English field holds the fake model's text and the note Draft proposed by gemini-2.5-flash-lite: check it before you save, and no button offers to replace it; the manifest unchanged until Save; after Save the viewer shows the English title (input budget translateDraft: 2)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §4.3; owner: assists-notify). In e2e/admin/specs/assists/drafts.spec.ts (state assist.draft).

scenarios.title: Bulk publish rebuilds the manifest and the viewer shows the photos
scenarios.asserts: three photos selected -> Publish -> each published, one manifest build (the publish status turns to up to date) -> the viewer served that manifest shows the three markers
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.5; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: Unpublishing hides the photo in the viewer
scenarios.asserts: Unpublish on a published photo -> published false -> the next manifest lacks it and the viewer no longer shows it; its public files stay until the sweep
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.5; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: Publishing rebuilds the manifest with every published document
scenarios.asserts: a build task -> manifest.json gzip in the public bucket with a 60-second cache; manifests/{city} records builtVersion, url, sha256, bytes and counts
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/publish/build-manifest.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A document the manifest refuses is skipped and listed
scenarios.asserts: one published document fails its manifest schema -> the manifest is published without it and manifests/{city}.skipped names it with its first issue
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/publish/build-manifest.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A city without its public token keeps the last good manifest
scenarios.asserts: no viewer token on the city -> status failed with apiError.mapbox.notConfigured; the last good url, sha256, counts and builtVersion stay; nothing uploaded
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/publish/build-manifest.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A change during a build queues the next build
scenarios.asserts: requestedVersion moves on while a build runs -> the build records the version it started from and queues another build task
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/publish/build-manifest.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A change the manifest does not carry requests no build
scenarios.asserts: a write to an unpublished document, or of the stamp and suggestions only -> no manifests/{city} change and no task
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/publish/fields.test.ts and functions/test/publish/on-write.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Photos that cannot be published are skipped with the reason
scenarios.asserts: a selection with a photo still processing, one failed and one with the licence unknown -> those three are listed with their reasons and stay unpublished; the rest are published; an English title is not required
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.5; owner: photos). Replaces S-A10-BAD-MISSING-EN-TITLE, which contradicted CR-1 of M1-interfaces.md (DECISIONS-for-review.md §34f). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-photos.tour.ts.

scenarios.title: Saving a new processed photo publishes it
scenarios.asserts: the editor of a processed photo with a known licence -> the Published switch starts on -> Save -> published in the same write; the viewer shows the photo
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §5.4; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: Confirming the rights of legacy photos clears the viewer's note
scenarios.asserts: the Rights review filter lists the photos with rightsReview -> Confirm rights on a selection -> rightsReview false -> the viewer's rights note is gone for them
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.5; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: Ranked scenes with footprints and browse previews
scenarios.asserts: Search -> ranked scenes (free first, then by score) with their footprints on the admin map and browse previews (copies in our bucket read with the Storage SDK, never a USGS address from the browser); for Bucharest the 1966, 1976, 1977, 1978 and 1980 frames rank on top
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts. The state check passes at every admin project since the CR-M3-35 fixes.

scenarios.title: Zero results show guidance
scenarios.asserts: zero results -> guidance (widen the years, all three datasets, the city's area in Settings)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts. The guidance answers CR-M3-35 (a): every year, all three collections, the scenes to order too, and the city's area in Settings.

scenarios.title: An M2M error shows an actionable message
scenarios.asserts: M2M error -> actionable message (apiError.usgs.maintenance retried later, apiError.usgs.unavailable with Try again, apiError.usgs.credentials with the link to Setup)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts. Maintenance says it retries, unavailable offers Try again, and the refused token links Setup's USGS step (CR-M3-35 b).

scenarios.title: Without USGS setup a link to setup is shown
scenarios.asserts: USGS not set up -> link to setup
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Every result says why it ranks where it does, in plain words
scenarios.asserts: each result lists its reasons (free, covers 92 % of the city, a target year, no layer within 8 years, no clouds recorded, about 2.75 m detail) in RO and EN; a scene of a year a layer already has ranks below one of a new year
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Filters narrow the results and the map together
scenarios.asserts: free only, a year range and a dataset narrow the list and the footprints on the map; clearing them restores both
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A browse image that cannot be fetched shows a placeholder with Try again
scenarios.asserts: the USGS browse host answers 503 -> 'Preview unavailable' with Try again on the card; the rest of the results work; the browser never requests a USGS address (firewall)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts. The state check passes at every admin project since the CR-M3-35 fixes.

scenarios.title: Before USGS approves downloads, results show but Import waits
scenarios.asserts: an account with the search role only -> the ranked results show, Import is off with apiError.usgs.accessPending and the link to Setup
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts. Import off with apiError.usgs.accessPending and the link to Setup (CR-M3-35 c); the cards offer no Import.

scenarios.title: The harvest stores and ranks every scene over the city
scenarios.asserts: imagery.search over corona2, declassii and declassiii -> usgsScenes documents with sensor, footprint, coverage, rank and reasons, the top 20 browse images copied; a second search updates and never duplicates; logout always runs
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/search.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: One dataset in maintenance does not stop the others
scenarios.asserts: declassiii answers the HTML 503 -> the other datasets are harvested and failedDatasets names declassiii
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/search.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: A browse address outside USGS is never fetched
scenarios.asserts: a scene whose browse address is not on ims.cr.usgs.gov -> no request is made (RemoteFiles allowedHosts) and browse.state stays failed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/search.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: A harvest USGS does not answer backs off instead of repeating every tick
scenarios.asserts: every dataset failing records a failed attempt (ops/harvest-{city}) and the tick waits an hour, then two; a harvest that found nothing waits a month; refused credentials mark the USGS card invalid and stop the tick's harvests
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: USGS not answering is said, never an empty area, and a check that found USGS down leaves search and import on
scenarios.asserts: every dataset failing answers apiError.usgs.unavailable (or maintenance when every one was), no scene written; a USGS record unavailable with its role kept still searches and imports
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: A free scene imports to a draft, is approved and appears in the viewer
scenarios.asserts: search -> one click Import (input budget <= 2) -> the job's steps advance live -> a draft whose checkpoint RMSE is over the threshold waits with its RMSE and compute-unit estimate -> Approve -> MTS mock -> the viewer shows the layer
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/published.spec.ts. The state check passes at every admin project since the CR-M3-35 fixes. Per push at admin-c360-ro and admin-l1440-ro, at the other three admin projects in tour-matrix (DECISIONS-for-review.md §49k).

scenarios.title: A georeferencing failure offers the georeferencer
scenarios.asserts: the automatic georeferencing finds too few pairs -> the job waits for points (awaiting_gcps) with apiError.imagery.noMatch and 'Open georeferencer'; saving points continues the same job
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/georeferencer.spec.ts (with S-A16-HAPPY: saving the points continues the same job). Leaving the georeferencer no longer throws (CR-M3-34: the drawing tools leave the map before it is removed).

scenarios.title: An import can be cancelled
scenarios.asserts: Cancel while running -> the Cloud Run execution cancelled, the job and its version cancelled, the reserved layer id free again
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/import.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A failed import can be retried successfully
scenarios.asserts: a failed job -> Retry -> it resumes from its first unfinished step (the done ones skipped) and succeeds
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/import.spec.ts. The state check passes at every admin project since the CR-M3-35 fixes.

scenarios.title: Under the threshold, Import is the only click
scenarios.asserts: a scene whose checkpoint RMSE is under the city's threshold -> Import (input budget: search and import) -> the layer appears in Layers, published, and in the viewer
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/published.spec.ts. The state check passes at every admin project since the CR-M3-35 fixes. Per push at admin-c360-ro and admin-l1440-ro, at the other three admin projects in tour-matrix (DECISIONS-for-review.md §49k).

scenarios.title: USGS maintenance makes the import wait, not fail
scenarios.asserts: the HTML 503 while the download is prepared -> 'USGS is under maintenance; it is retried automatically' (waiting_usgs) -> the next tick resumes it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/import.spec.ts. The state check passes at every admin project since the CR-M3-35 fixes.

scenarios.title: A scene that is not scanned cannot be imported
scenarios.asserts: imagery.import of a scene whose download is not available -> apiError.imagery.notScanned; no job, version or layer id written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/import.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: A scene is imported once
scenarios.asserts: a second imagery.import of the same scene -> apiError.imagery.alreadyImported naming the layer
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/import.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: The budget guard pauses imports, never the site
scenarios.asserts: ops/guard red -> imagery.import answers apiError.guardPaused and queued jobs wait (waitReason guard); the manifest and the viewer are untouched
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/import.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: At most ten raster jobs a day
scenarios.asserts: the 11th raster job of a day -> apiError.imagery.dailyLimit with the limit
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/import.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: A queued job starts exactly one execution
scenarios.asserts: a queued job -> one Cloud Run execution (raster-pipeline, raster-pipeline-xl for a KH-9 panoramic frame) with JOB_ID, CITY_ID and the args run; a redelivered trigger starts nothing more; a third running job waits (capacity)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/dispatch.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: A lost or out-of-memory execution runs again, then gives up
scenarios.asserts: a running job whose lease lapsed and whose execution failed out of memory -> dispatched again on raster-pipeline-xl (attempt 2); past JOB_MAX_ATTEMPTS -> failed with apiError.imagery.attemptsExhausted
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/tick.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: A publish not yet at Mapbox can be cancelled; one at Mapbox is never ended by a stale reject
scenarios.asserts: Cancel on a publish before its publish call ends the job and its version and frees the reservation, and a start after it sends Mapbox nothing; a job Mapbox works on stays; a rejection that read a waiting job refuses once the guard sent it to Mapbox
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: Dispatchers racing for the last place start one run
scenarios.asserts: two dispatches that both counted one run before either transaction start exactly one execution (ops/dispatch slots); a slot whose run ended or whose city is gone is freed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: A failure no retry cures offers no Try again
scenarios.asserts: an import failed out of memory on the large machine shows its error without Try again; imagery.retry refuses a token, scope or memory failure and an upload refused before any version
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: A failed version is dismissed, asked first
scenarios.asserts: Dismiss asks first; confirmed, the version is rejected (its job stays failed) and leaves Waiting for you; a version that left failed meanwhile is not dismissed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: Buying a scan is prepared, tracked and imported on its own when delivered
scenarios.asserts: a scene USGS has not scanned (Free only off): its order card says 35 USD (30 USD a frame and 5 USD an order, paid to USGS) with the guide, and links to the scene's EarthExplorer page (its dataset id and entity id, a new tab); EarthExplorer and I ordered it are the flow's two inputs -> the chip Ordered with the next check; the fake USGS delivers; Check now -> Importing with a link to the import: a usgs-import job created by the admin exists without another click, and the event order.delivered is written for the admins' inbox (the inbox itself: S-A46-HAPPY)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1; owner: orders). In e2e/admin/specs/imagery/orders.spec.ts (states orders.order-card, orders.ordered).

scenarios.title: An order not delivered after a week reminds the admin to pay, and one never delivered is ordered again
scenarios.asserts: orders seeded as the watch leaves them: a week old with a reminder sent and its last check failed for maintenance -> its card says Ordered: have you paid?, the 14-day warning, that an admin who paid has nothing to do, and the failed check in words, and Work does not count it; a delivered one says its import is starting; one never delivered is the one Work counts, says so and offers I ordered it again and Take the mark back (the watch's reminders on days 7 and 12 and its day-90 give-up are the functions rows S-A13-HAPPY-WATCH, S-A13-BAD-USGS-DOWN and S-A13-BAD-EXPIRED)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.2, §1.5, §1.7; owner: orders). In e2e/admin/specs/imagery/orders.spec.ts (states orders.reminder, orders.delivered, orders.expired).

scenarios.title: An available scene cannot be marked as ordered
scenarios.asserts: a scene USGS lists as downloadable shows Import (free) and no order card, no EarthExplorer link and no I ordered it; the same scene in the list carries the chip Free
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.4, §1.7; owner: orders). In e2e/admin/specs/imagery/orders.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: An order marked by mistake is taken back
scenarios.asserts: I ordered it, then the snackbar's Undo -> the chip Must be ordered from USGS again and the order card offers EarthExplorer and I ordered it again, no order stored; marked again, then Take the mark back on the card -> the same, and a tick asks USGS nothing about it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.4; owner: orders). In e2e/admin/specs/imagery/orders.spec.ts; the callable in functions/test/imagery/orders.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The daily watch asks USGS once a day per order and imports a delivered scan
scenarios.asserts: imagery.tick's orders step: one login per run, download-options batched per dataset for the orders due (at most 50 a run), nextCheckAt one day later; a delivery -> the order delivered and the scene free, then the import job and its version created in one transaction (createdBy the admin who ordered), the order importing with importJobId and the event order.delivered; the version out of processing -> imported and the event order.imported linking to it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.5; owner: orders). In functions/test/imagery/orders-watch.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Marking a scene USGS already offers is refused
scenarios.asserts: usgs.markOrdered on a scene whose download-options says available -> apiError.usgs.alreadyAvailable, the scene's downloadAvailable set true and ranked again, no order written; on an order already watched -> apiError.usgs.orderState
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.4; owner: orders). In functions/test/imagery/orders.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame USGS scanned while it was being marked still says why I ordered it was refused
scenarios.asserts: the fake USGS offers the paid frame, then I ordered it -> usgs.markOrdered records it free and answers apiError.usgs.alreadyAvailable; the order card goes (Import is free now), the snackbar says why in words and the keyboard is on the scene's heading; Import enabled
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.4, §1.7; owner: orders). In e2e/admin/specs/imagery/orders.spec.ts (state orders.scanned-while-marking). Added by the 2026-10-24 review fixes (DECISIONS-for-review.md §57).

scenarios.title: Before USGS approves downloads, the order cards say the daily check waits for it
scenarios.asserts: setup/status usgs pending (search role only) -> the card of a scene to buy and the card of an order each say USGS has not approved the account's downloads and the daily check starts once it does, with the link to Setup's USGS step; the order's next check reads after USGS approves downloads
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.5, §1.7; owner: orders). In e2e/admin/specs/imagery/orders.spec.ts (state orders.waits-for-approval). Added by the 2026-10-24 review fixes (DECISIONS-for-review.md §57).

scenarios.title: An order never delivered within 90 days expires
scenarios.asserts: day 90 without delivery -> expired with expiredAt, the event order.expired once, no more checks; a later Check now that finds the download -> delivered and imported as usual
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.2, §1.5; owner: orders). In functions/test/imagery/orders-watch.test.ts and orders.test.ts (Check now after expiry).

scenarios.title: USGS maintenance during the watch retries sooner and loses no reminder
scenarios.asserts: download-options answers the maintenance HTML 503 -> nextCheckAt six hours later, lastError apiError.usgs.maintenance on the card; the day-7 reminder is still sent that day (reminders do not ask USGS)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.5; owner: orders). In functions/test/imagery/orders-watch.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A delivery while the budget guard is red waits, then imports once it is green
scenarios.asserts: a red ops/guard (or today's JOBS_PER_DAY reached) -> the order stays delivered and no job is created; the first tick after the guard turns green (or the next day) creates the import once
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.5; owner: orders). In functions/test/imagery/orders-watch.test.ts and orders.test.ts (Check now).

scenarios.title: Check now twice within a minute asks USGS once
scenarios.asserts: the second usgs.checkOrder within ORDER_CHECK_NOW_MIN_SECONDS -> apiError.rateLimited, the fake USGS counts one download-options call
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.4; owner: orders). In functions/test/imagery/orders.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An admin can no longer mark a scene ordered with the Firestore SDK
scenarios.asserts: an admin's update of usgsScenes status to ordered or available is denied (the order is usgs.markOrdered's), and so is any write of order (set or removed) or eeDatasetId; candidate and rejected with a note stay allowed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.8; owner: orders). In firebase/rules-tests/test/jobs.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A georeferenced GeoTIFF goes straight to the publish path
scenarios.asserts: a georeferenced GeoTIFF uploaded -> inspect finds its georeference -> warp, export -> the approval card (never automatic: no measured error)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/upload.spec.ts. Needs CR-M3-32 (imagery.onRasterUpload reads only the dialog's metadata keys).

scenarios.title: A GeoTIFF without georeference opens the georeferencer
scenarios.asserts: a TIFF without georeference -> the job waits for points (awaiting_gcps) -> the georeferencer opens on its scan
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/upload.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A non-TIFF upload shows an error

scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/upload.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A large upload resumes after an interruption
scenarios.asserts: a large file -> the resumable upload continues after the network drops and completes; one job

scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/history/revert.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The creation entry has nothing to restore
scenarios.asserts: the entry of a create offers no Revert; history.revert of it answers apiError.history.nothingToRestore
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/history/revert.test.ts.

scenarios.title: No client can write or forge history
scenarios.asserts: an admin creating, changing or deleting any history entry with the Firestore SDK is denied; reading it is allowed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by firebase/rules-tests/test/history.test.ts, for each of the five audited entities.

scenarios.title: A deleted place is restored from History
scenarios.asserts: the Deleted filter lists the deleted place -> Restore (asked first) -> the place is back with its fields
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.2; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A refused revert explains why and changes nothing
scenarios.asserts: a version that today's schema refuses -> Revert answers apiError.history.invalidSnapshot with the count, as an alert; the document is unchanged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.2; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: Another city's changes never reach this city's History
scenarios.asserts: a newer deletion in another city of the same project -> History's recent changes and its Deleted filter do not list it, and the city's few entries offer no Show more; the query asks one city's entries by the cityId each entry carries, and only that city's entries answer it (rules test)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.2, CR-M2c-14; docs/LESSONS.md 149). Also firebase/rules-tests/test/history.test.ts and packages/admin/test/history/history.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A layer whose tileset was deleted is not restored
scenarios.asserts: history.revert of a layer's delete entry after its layer-delete job succeeded -> apiError.history.layerGone; nothing written; while the job still waits, the restore cancels it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.4, CR-M2c-5; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A photo restored after the sweep is processed again
scenarios.asserts: history.revert of a photo's delete entry whose public files were swept -> the photo comes back with processing pending, off the public map, and is processed again from its kept original, then shows as before
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.6, CR-M2c-5; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A crash report from the site reaches Cloud Error Reporting, redacted
scenarios.asserts: POST text/plain from an allowed origin -> 204; one ERROR log entry of type ReportedErrorEvent with service viewer (admin for the admin origin), the release and a report location; no query, token or e-mail address in it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/telemetry/report-error.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A report from an unknown site is refused
scenarios.asserts: Origin not among the viewer and admin origins -> 403 apiError.telemetry.origin; nothing logged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/telemetry/report-error.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An error storm is capped
scenarios.asserts: the 11th report of one client within a minute -> 429 apiError.rateLimited with Retry-After; at most the per-minute limits are logged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/telemetry/report-error.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An oversized report is refused before it is parsed
scenarios.asserts: a body over 16 KiB -> 413 apiError.telemetry.tooLarge; nothing logged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/telemetry/report-error.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A malformed report is refused
scenarios.asserts: invalid JSON, an unknown field or a page address with its hash -> 400 apiError.invalidRequest; nothing logged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/telemetry/report-error.test.ts.

scenarios.title: On one origin the page's path tells the admin's crash from the viewer's
scenarios.asserts: a report from a page under /admin/ -> logged as the admin's; from / or a city path -> the viewer's
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §2.3; owner: hosting). Finding 14 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: functions/test/telemetry/report-error.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A report whose page is not on its own origin is refused
scenarios.asserts: a report whose page names another origin than its Origin header -> refused, nothing logged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §2.3; owner: hosting). Finding 14 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: functions/test/telemetry/report-error.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Before Blaze the owner signs in and sets up without any server
scenarios.asserts: a start-up deploy (runtime.json says startUp: the Hosting-only deploy of a new map) calls nothing of the server, the probe included, and the browser logs no console error -> Sign in asks Google for read-only Cloud access with the consent note -> testIamPermissions on the mock proves ownership -> Setup in start-up mode with only the Setup destination; no Firestore, Storage or callable request until the server's installation
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration). Since 2026-10-18 (the live polish of the deployed admin): the start-up deploy, without the probe's CORS error.

scenarios.title: A Hosting-only deploy that does not say start-up still starts the setup
scenarios.asserts: runtime.json without startUp and no server -> the anonymous probe of admin-session gets no answer (the browser logs its error) -> the same start-up sign-in with the read-only consent note
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c follow-ups (2026-10-18). e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A Google account that does not own the project cannot start the setup
scenarios.asserts: testIamPermissions grants nothing and Cloud Functions was never enabled -> adminShell.auth.notOwner naming the project id and Use another Google account (the sign-out); nothing else called
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A set-up map whose server does not answer shows a retry, not the setup
scenarios.asserts: a non-owner, Cloud Functions enabled, the server not answering -> adminShell.backend.down with Try again; once the server answers Try again opens the normal sign-in flow
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A reload in start-up mode keeps the detected steps but no token
scenarios.asserts: reload after billing -> the steps show their state from the app's sessionStorage record, which holds no access token, e-mail address or secret (beside it only Firebase Auth's own session of the tab, never a Google token); the next step asks Google again
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A page that needs the server opens Setup in start-up mode
scenarios.asserts: the address #/photos in start-up mode -> Setup with adminShell.route.needsBackend
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: When the server appears the owner claims the map without a click
scenarios.asserts: the mock Cloud Functions list goes from none to every registry function ACTIVE and the server answers -> admin.claim with the in-memory token, no click -> ID token refreshed -> setup.createCity and setup.recordCloud with the start-up results -> normal mode with the full navigation, Setup opens at Mapbox
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: A partial or failed deployment is shown and nothing is claimed
scenarios.asserts: some functions missing -> the ready and total counts, no claim; one FAILED function -> adminSetup.deploy.failed naming it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: Without a live Google token the claim costs one click
scenarios.asserts: the page was reloaded before the server appeared -> Confirm with Google (one click, one read-only consent) -> claimed; nothing claimed before the click
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A refused claim is explained and leaves the account without admin rights
scenarios.asserts: admin.claim answers apiError.claim.tokenMismatch or apiError.claim.alreadyClaimed -> its message; no admins document, no claim, Retry or sign-out
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: Each step asks Google for its own scope only
scenarios.asserts: the recorded consent requests: read-only Cloud at sign-in in start-up mode, cloud-billing at billing, cloud-platform at provisioning, analytics.edit at the GA4 setting, each with the signed-in account as login hint; daily use after the setup asks for none
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: Every consent explains why, for how long, and Google's unverified-app screen
scenarios.asserts: before the sign-in, billing and GA4-stream popups the panel or card shows why, that the permission stays in the tab for at most an hour, and how to continue past the unverified-app screen to the auth domain, in Romanian and English (the admin-l1440-en project)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: An unticked scope stops the step before any Google call
scenarios.asserts: the scope unticked on the consent page -> adminShell.oauth.scopeDenied naming the permission; no Google API called with the token; Retry asks again
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A cancelled consent changes nothing
scenarios.asserts: Cancel on the consent page of a setup step -> adminShell.oauth.popupClosed; the step is as before
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: Choosing another Google account on the consent page is refused
scenarios.asserts: another account chosen -> adminShell.oauth.wrongAccount; the token is dropped and nothing called with it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A Google access token is never stored or sent elsewhere
scenarios.asserts: after every step no Google access token is found in localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, cookies or the address, nor in any request other than to Google and admin.claim
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: One click imports the 45 legacy photos through the photo pipeline
scenarios.asserts: Import the 45 photos (one click) -> 45 photo documents with their legacyId, each original uploaded and processed by photos.onUpload, published once processed with rightsReview kept -> the manifest lists them; input budget 1
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: Importing again creates nothing new
scenarios.asserts: a second import -> no new document, no new upload; the city still has 45 legacy photos
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: An interrupted import finishes the missing photos only
scenarios.asserts: the page closed after some uploads -> the next import uploads only the photos without an image and finishes
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A photo that fails processing is listed and the rest are imported
scenarios.asserts: one original fails processing -> listed with its apiError.photo reason; the other 44 are imported and published
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A photo whose upload event was lost is processed again after two minutes
scenarios.asserts: an upload whose event never arrives -> after two minutes (clock) the import asks photos.reprocess once -> the photo is processed and published; the import does not wait ten minutes
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.2; owner: server-bugs). Finding 17 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Covered by e2e/admin/steps/legacy.spec.ts (the first upload sent to a name photos.onUpload ignores; photos.reprocess runs for real).

scenarios.title: A photo still stuck after the second try is listed with the server check
scenarios.asserts: the second event lost too -> listed as not processed because the server did not receive the upload, with a link to the server checks; the other photos imported
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.2; owner: server-bugs). Finding 17 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Covered by e2e/admin/steps/legacy.spec.ts (the second event lost too: the page's photos.reprocess call is answered without a copy, as the emulators always deliver a server-side copy's event); the failure links the step that grants roles/run.invoker.

scenarios.title: The end of the import is said in a snackbar
scenarios.asserts: the last photo published -> a snackbar All 45 photos are on the map, announced, while Setup moves to the next step
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 19 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/legacy.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: An import that ends with failures says how many and where
scenarios.asserts: a photo failed processing -> a snackbar 44 of 45 photos are on the map with Open, which opens the import card with its list
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 19 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/legacy.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: The navigation follows the window class
scenarios.asserts: compact: navigation bar with Setup, Photos, Places, Layers and More; medium and expanded: collapsed rail; large: expanded rail; the active route is marked and survives a reload
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: An unknown address opens Setup
scenarios.asserts: an unknown hash -> Setup with the adminShell.route.notFound snackbar, which passes the layout and accessibility checkers
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5). Since 2026-10-17: e2e/admin/specs/smoke.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A landscape phone gets a rail instead of the bar
scenarios.asserts: 915 x 412 (compact height) -> the collapsed rail instead of the bar; no floating control overlaps and none leaves the screen
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: Editors follow the canonical list and detail layout
scenarios.asserts: at 360 px the list fills the page and a job opens a full-screen item without the navigation bar; at 768 px one pane beside the rail; at 1440 px the list and the item side by side; the item's heading takes the focus and Esc returns to the list with the focus on the job
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §1.2, §1.3; owner: ops-screens). Back and Close return to the list in the other operations journeys of the same spec.

scenarios.title: A deep link to an editor on a phone keeps Back inside the admin
scenarios.asserts: a place editor's address opened directly at 360 px -> the full-screen editor; Back, the button or the browser's, shows the places list, never the previous site
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §1.2; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: Rotating a phone with the account menu open keeps the focus on the account button
scenarios.asserts: 360 x 800, the account menu open -> turned to 800 x 360 (the menu moves from the top bar to the rail's foot) -> the dialog is gone and the account button has the focus; turned back, the same from the rail to the top bar
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c follow-ups (the hardening review's follow-up, 2026-10-18). e2e/admin/specs/smoke.spec.ts; packages/ui/test/admin/shell/shell-layout.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A page whose chunk does not load says so and Try again loads it
scenarios.asserts: the jobs page's chunk lost once on the way -> the shell's page area says the page did not load (an alert) with Try again, which passes the checkers at every tour viewport; Try again -> the page loads and the alert is gone
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c follow-up (DECISIONS-for-review.md §34b: each area's page is a lazy chunk; owner: ops-screens). e2e/tour/admin-jobs.tour.ts; the state admin.page-failed.

scenarios.title: The Setup cards that report a failure stay sound and announce it
scenarios.asserts: provisioning with Secret Manager down, and a Mapbox demo account refused -> the failure is announced by a live region and the card with the failed item, Retry and the alert passes the layout and accessibility checkers
scenarios.notes: Since 2026-10-17. The user's request of 2026-10-12 ('in the phone screens the menu button sometimes overlaps with other elements. we should have tests for overlapping elements!!! also for accessibility!!'): the generic checkers of e2e/support/layout.ts and e2e/support/a11y.ts over the state inventory e2e/tour/states.ts (docs/TESTING.md, The tour's checkers).

scenarios.title: Every editor state passes the checkers at every tour viewport, light and dark
scenarios.asserts: each M2c state of the inventory (lists, editors, map drawing, dialogs, sheets, snackbars, empty, loading and error states) at the 11 tour viewports in light and dark -> the generic layout and accessibility checkers pass; Esc closes each dialog and menu with the focus back on its opener
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §12.2; owner: each area for its states). Runtime: DECISIONS-for-review.md §34c.

scenarios.title: The map editors keep a sound Tab order and a visible focus
scenarios.asserts: an editor with the map: the Tab round reaches the map, the drawing toolbar, the vertex list and the form in visual order, the map's ring is visible and uncut, and nothing under a modal sheet or dialog is reachable
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §3.3, §4.6; owner: pois).

scenarios.asserts: the admin loading at every tour viewport -> no page scrollbar, the indicator centred; tour state shell.loading
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 1 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/specs/shell/setup-layout.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: A boot that turns into its error card still fits

scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 1 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/specs/shell/setup-layout.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: The start-up sign-in card is centred
scenarios.asserts: start-up mode at the medium window class and wider -> the card centred on both axes; on a compact-height window it starts at the top without clipping
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 2 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/specs/shell/setup-layout.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: A refused account's longer card stays centred and whole
scenarios.asserts: a non-owner signs in -> the refusal card centred, its text whole at 320 by 568, in both languages
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 2 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/specs/shell/setup-layout.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: A busy step's chip shows the indicator in place of its icon

scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 6 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/specs/shell/setup-layout.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: With reduced motion the busy chip is still whole

scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 6 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/specs/shell/setup-layout.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: The shell's surface fills the window when the content is short

scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 22 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/specs/shell/setup-layout.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: Scrolling past the end shows no band of another colour

scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 22 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/specs/shell/setup-layout.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: The whole Setup Assistant takes at most eleven inputs and four consents
scenarios.asserts: from sign-in to the legacy import with the mocks, since M6 to Publish the map: at most 11 in-app inputs and 4 Google consents (setupInputBudget; 9 before M6 left the server, the pipeline and the site to a terminal); the human-only work on the providers' pages is not counted

scenarios.title: A failed step costs one more input, never a re-entry
scenarios.asserts: a provisioning item fails, then Retry -> one more input; nothing detected is asked again

scenarios.title: The daily flows stay within their input budgets

scenarios.title: The whole Setup, server and public map included, takes no terminal

scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §4.1, §4.2; owner: installer). Finding 13 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts (M6 integrator).

scenarios.title: An hour between steps costs one consent, never a re-entry
scenarios.asserts: Publish the map more than an hour after Prepare the project -> one consent from the same click; nothing detected is asked again
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §4.2; owner: installer). Finding 13 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts (M6 integrator).

scenarios.title: A place drawn as a polygon is saved and appears in the viewer
scenarios.asserts: Add place, Area, four clicks (the click tools close the ring themselves) -> the polygon previews live; the title typed; Save -> the POI document with one closed ring of five positions, published; the manifest's pois carry it and the viewer draws it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §4.4, §7.2; owner: pois).

scenarios.title: Moving, inserting and deleting vertices previews live and saves the new shape
scenarios.asserts: the open place selected on the map (Terra Draw) -> a vertex dragged moves it and a midpoint dragged inserts a vertex there, the list of positions following each drag; a position removed from the list; Save -> the new geometry
