scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §4.4; owner: pois).

scenarios.title: A place can be drawn without a pointer
scenarios.asserts: the vertex list: Add at map centre after moving the map with the arrow keys, latitude and longitude typed, a vertex removed -> the same document as with the pointer; no pointer event used
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §4.6; owner: pois).

scenarios.title: A vertex outside the city is refused live
scenarios.asserts: a click beyond the city bounds plus 0.5 degrees -> no vertex added and an alert names the limit; a drag outside snaps back; nothing outside the city is written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §4.5; owner: pois).

scenarios.title: A polygon whose edges cross is refused
scenarios.asserts: the closing click of a bow-tie polygon -> refused with a message; the last valid shape stays
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §4.5; owner: pois).

scenarios.title: The 501st vertex is refused
scenarios.asserts: a geometry of 500 positions -> the next vertex is refused with the limit named (MAX_GEOMETRY_VERTICES)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §4.5; owner: pois).

scenarios.title: Without the admin's Mapbox token places are still editable by coordinates
scenarios.asserts: no admin token in setup/status -> the map area explains it with a link to the Mapbox step; the vertex list and every field still work and Save writes
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §1.4, §3.4; owner: pois). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-places.tour.ts (Add at centre, typed and removed positions, the texts, Save, then Delete after its question).

scenarios.title: A whole place is dragged by its inside
scenarios.asserts: the open area pressed inside and moved 40 px east -> every position moved by the same amount, none north or south; Save writes it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c follow-up (DECISIONS-for-review.md §34g; owner: pois). e2e/admin/specs/pois/dragging.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A vertex dragged across the opposite edge stops before the area crosses itself
scenarios.asserts: the south-west corner dragged north past the northern edge -> it stays below that edge (Terra Draw refuses a crossing move), nothing crossing reaches the draft or Firestore
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c follow-up (DECISIONS-for-review.md §34g; owner: pois). e2e/admin/specs/pois/dragging.spec.ts; a drag past the city's limits is refused and said (packages/ui/test/map/draw/terra-draw-real.test.ts: the limits are half a degree beyond the city, off screen at the city's zoom).

scenarios.title: A place opened in its editor is brought into view on the map
scenarios.asserts: a place about 6 km north of the city's start view, opened by its address on the places page -> the same map centres on the place's bounding box, its zoom kept and without animation
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2e review (owner: pois). e2e/admin/specs/pois/in-view.spec.ts; packages/admin/test/pois/map-session.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A new place, with nothing drawn yet, leaves the map where it was
scenarios.asserts: Add place, Point -> the map stays at the city's start view (no shape to bring into view); an edit of the open place moves the camera neither
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2e review (owner: pois). e2e/admin/specs/pois/in-view.spec.ts; packages/admin/test/pois/map-session.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Deleting a photo asks first and Undo restores it
scenarios.asserts: Delete -> a dialog naming the photo and saying it leaves the public map within a minute -> Delete -> gone from the list and the map; the snackbar's Undo -> history.revert of the delete entry -> the photo is back as it was; the manifest follows both
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.5; owner: ops-screens with photos).

scenarios.title: Bulk delete of places is restored from History
scenarios.asserts: five places selected -> Delete (one dialog naming the count) -> gone; History's Deleted filter -> Restore brings each back
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §7.3, §9.5; owner: pois).

scenarios.title: Deleting a layer queues its tileset deletion after a grace period
scenarios.asserts: Delete on a layer -> layers.delete -> the layer document is gone and a layer-delete job waits until seven days later (shown on Jobs); restoring the layer before then cancels the job; the raster pipeline runs it (M3)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.4; owner: layers-settings).

scenarios.title: Cancel keeps everything
scenarios.asserts: Cancel, Esc or the scrim in the delete dialog -> nothing deleted and the focus back on Delete
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.5; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A category in use is deleted only after its places move
scenarios.asserts: Delete on a category used by three places -> the dialog asks where to move them (one choice) -> the places get that category and the category is deleted; without a choice nothing changes
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.5; owner: layers-settings). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-settings.tour.ts.

scenarios.title: No client deletes a layer or queues its tileset deletion
scenarios.asserts: an admin deleting a layer document, or creating a layer-delete job, with the Firestore SDK -> denied; layers.delete is the only way
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.4, CR-M2c-3, CR-M2c-6; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A deleted layer's tileset goes after the grace
scenarios.asserts: a layer-delete job past its seven days -> the tileset and its source deleted at Mapbox (fake) with retries, the layer's objects in our bucket deleted, the job succeeded; a layer restored meanwhile -> the job cancelled
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/layer-delete.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23). CR-M2c-13 of docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md.

scenarios.title: A deleted layer's id stays taken until its deletion runs, which spares any newer version
scenarios.asserts: an import of the same label during the grace gets another id; a due deletion waits while an unfinished version holds the id and deletes only the files of the deleted layer's own versions
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: A GeoJSON file is previewed and imported as places
scenarios.asserts: a FeatureCollection chosen -> the preview counts new, updated and refused features and shows them on the map -> one category chosen for the uncategorised -> Import -> batched writes; the list and the map show them; one manifest build; inputBudget 3
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §7.4; owner: pois).

scenarios.title: Exporting and importing the same file changes nothing
scenarios.asserts: Export -> a GeoJSON file of every place (ids, categories, texts, years, links, photos) -> importing it -> 0 new, 0 changed, nothing written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §7.4; owner: pois). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-places.tour.ts.

scenarios.title: A file that is not GeoJSON is refused before any write
scenarios.asserts: a JPEG, malformed JSON, or a file over 5 MB -> one message, no preview, nothing written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §7.4; owner: pois). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-places.tour.ts (a text file); the JPEG, malformed JSON and over-5-MB cases by packages/admin/test/pois/importer.test.ts and geojson.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Invalid features are listed and left out
scenarios.asserts: a MultiPolygon, a position with altitude, an open ring, a position outside the city and an unknown category -> each refused with its reason; the valid features import
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §7.4; owner: pois). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-places.tour.ts.

scenarios.title: Markup in imported properties stays text
scenarios.asserts: a title and a description holding HTML -> shown as characters in the preview, stored as text, and the viewer shows the characters, never markup
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §7.4, §10.3; owner: pois).

scenarios.title: An import past the 5000-place limit is refused whole
scenarios.asserts: existing plus new places above MAX_POIS -> refused before any write with the numbers
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §7.4; owner: pois).

scenarios.title: Image adjustments preview live and reach the viewer on save
scenarios.asserts: the brightness, contrast and saturation sliders moved -> the admin map's pixel probe changes at once with nothing written -> Save -> adjustments without neutral values; the manifest carries them and the viewer shows the same probe as the admin did
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §5.2, §8.3; owner: layers-settings).

scenarios.title: Reset returns every adjustment to neutral
scenarios.asserts: Reset -> all four sliders neutral and the map shows the raw tile live -> Save removes adjustments from the document
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.3; owner: layers-settings).

scenarios.title: Brightness minimum never passes the maximum
scenarios.asserts: the minimum dragged past the maximum -> it stops at the maximum live, the image is never inverted, and the saved document keeps the minimum at or below the maximum
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.3; owner: layers-settings).

scenarios.title: Leaving without saving restores the stored look
scenarios.asserts: adjustments moved, then Discard or another page -> the map shows the stored adjustments; nothing written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §5.2; owner: layers-settings).

scenarios.title: Keyboard input keeps every adjustment in range
scenarios.asserts: arrows, PageUp, PageDown, Home and End on each slider -> values within LAYER_ADJUSTMENT_RANGES, announced as signed percentages
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.3; owner: layers-settings). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-layers.tour.ts.

scenarios.title: Default opacities preview live and the viewer opens with them
scenarios.asserts: Overlay defaults: a layer to 40 %, the photos to 60 %, a category to 30 % -> each fades live on the settings map (its paint) -> Save -> the layer's opacity, photosOverlay.defaultOpacity and the category's defaultOpacity written; the manifest carries them; the viewer opens with those slider values and the layer's pixel probe
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5; owner: layers-settings). Since 2026-10-18 (§42a): e2e/admin/specs/settings/map.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A layer's shown-at-start switch reaches the viewer
scenarios.asserts: Shown at start on -> defaultVisible true -> the viewer starts with the layer shown
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.2; owner: layers-settings). e2e/admin/specs/flows/publish.spec.ts (the viewer served the built manifest).

scenarios.title: Unsaved defaults are discarded
scenarios.asserts: sliders moved, then Discard -> the map returns to the stored opacities; nothing written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5; owner: layers-settings). Since 2026-10-18 (§42a): e2e/admin/specs/settings/map.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A visitor's own opacity in the link still wins
scenarios.asserts: a viewer address whose op= gives the layer 90 after its default became 40 % -> the layer shows at 90 % (V23)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5; owner: layers-settings).

scenarios.title: Replacing a published photo swaps the image at once and keeps it published
scenarios.asserts: Replace image -> upload with progress -> while it is processed the viewer still shows the old image -> photos.onUpload -> image.sha256 changes in one write, the manifest names the new files and the viewer shows the new thumbnail; the old files are swept later
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.4; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: A refused replacement keeps the current image
scenarios.asserts: an HEIC file, or a duplicate of another photo, as the replacement -> the reason is shown and the photo stays published with its image
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.4; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: The server keeps a photo's image when its replacement is refused
scenarios.asserts: photos.onUpload refuses an upload for a photo that has an image -> processing stays done, the image is unchanged, replacement records the refusal
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.4, CR-M2c-4; owner: photos). Covered by functions/test/photos/replacement.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Cancelling a replacement mid-upload changes nothing
scenarios.asserts: Cancel during the upload -> no new object; the photo and the viewer unchanged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.4; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: Replacing with the same file changes nothing
scenarios.asserts: the photo's own file again -> the same derivatives, no new public file, and a note says it is the same image
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.4; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: An edit previews live and one Save writes it with its history
scenarios.asserts: a field changed -> the map and the list preview it with nothing written -> Save -> one stamped update (updatedBy, updatedAt) and a history entry with the previous version; the publish status shows updating, then up to date after the manifest build
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §5; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: Leaving with unsaved changes asks first
scenarios.asserts: another page, Back, closing the editor or signing out with changes -> Keep editing or Discard; Keep editing keeps the draft and the address; a reload gets the browser's leave prompt
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §2.4; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A change saved by another admin is never overwritten silently
scenarios.asserts: another admin saves the same document -> a banner names them and the time; fields only they changed merge in; for a field both changed, Keep mine or Take theirs
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §5.1, §5.3; owner: ops-screens). Since 2026-10-18 (DECISIONS-for-review.md §42c) the banner names the other admin (from admins.list) and when they saved, with the fields in words: e2e/admin/specs/pois/conflict.spec.ts saves as a second admin.

scenarios.title: Invalid fields are shown at the field and nothing is written
scenarios.asserts: a blank Romanian title, an end year before the start, an http link -> each field marked invalid with its message; Save off, its description naming the first problem; nothing written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §1.6, §5.3; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A save while offline keeps the draft
scenarios.asserts: the network gone -> Save says it could not reach the server and keeps every change; Save again once online writes it once
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §5.3; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A document deleted elsewhere is not recreated by Save
scenarios.asserts: another admin deletes the open document -> the editor says so and offers Restore (History) or Close; Save is off
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §5.1; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A document the public map skipped is shown with its issue
scenarios.asserts: the manifest build skips a published document -> Not on the public map lists it with its first issue and a link to its editor
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §5.4; owner: ops-screens). Since 2026-10-18 (DECISIONS-for-review.md §42b) Home lists each skipped document: e2e/admin/specs/ops/skipped.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A new category with its icon, colour and default opacity reaches the viewer
scenarios.asserts: Add category: label RO and EN (the icon follows the label: Fântâni gives water, no click in the picker; POI_ICONS, labelled in both languages), a colour, 80 % -> Save -> the place editor offers it, the manifest lists it and the viewer's Layers panel shows its swatch and slider at 80 %
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5; owner: layers-settings).

scenarios.title: Reordering categories reorders the viewer's list
scenarios.asserts: a drag, or Move up and Move down -> the order written for each -> the viewer's Places group follows
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5; owner: layers-settings).

scenarios.title: A colour the icon cannot be read on is adjusted
scenarios.asserts: a colour under 3:1 against the white glyph -> a warning and the nearest passing tone proposed; Save keeps a passing colour
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5; owner: layers-settings). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-settings.tour.ts.

scenarios.title: A category named like an overlay gets an id of its own
scenarios.asserts: a label that slugifies to photos or to a layer's id -> a suffixed id; the manifest never reports validation.duplicateId
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5; owner: layers-settings).

scenarios.title: An icon outside the bundled set is kept and explained
scenarios.asserts: a category whose icon is not bundled -> the picker says it is drawn as the pin and keeps it until another is chosen
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5; owner: layers-settings). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-settings.tour.ts.

scenarios.title: A label the icons do not know keeps the pin, and a picked icon stays
scenarios.asserts: a new category labelled with no word the icons know (Corona 1968) -> the pin (DEFAULT_POI_ICON); an icon picked by hand is kept when the label changes to one that would suggest another (Fântâni) and saved
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5, Addendum 2026-10-18 minimum input; owner: layers-settings). The guess itself: packages/admin/test/settings/icon-guess.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The 51st category is refused
scenarios.asserts: at 50 categories Add category is off with the limit named (MAX_POI_CATEGORIES)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5; owner: layers-settings). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-settings.tour.ts.

scenarios.title: The dashboard counts the city and says what waits for an admin
scenarios.asserts: #/home -> the photos, places, categories and layers counts, the photos in rights review, the unpublished photos, the running and failed jobs, each a link to its page; the public map's state; a running job's tile leads to the jobs
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (CR-M2c-24; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A service that needs attention is named with its reason
scenarios.asserts: setup/status with Mapbox invalid (a refused token) -> the Mapbox chip says it needs attention, as text, and Open Setup leads to #/setup
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (CR-M2c-24; owner: ops-screens). A count that cannot be read shows a dash, never a wrong number: packages/ui/test/admin/ops/crashes-home.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Once Setup is complete an empty address opens the dashboard
scenarios.asserts: setup/status with billing, provisioning, Mapbox and USGS ok -> the admin's address without a route opens Home, marked in the navigation; on a phone the bar holds Home, Photos, Places and Layers (Setup under More); after a reload the browser remembers it and Home opens at once
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c follow-up (DECISIONS-for-review.md §34i; owner: ops-screens). e2e/admin/specs/ops/ops.spec.ts; packages/admin/test/app/navigation.test.ts, setup-readiness.test.ts.

scenarios.title: While Setup is not complete an empty address still opens Setup
scenarios.asserts: setup/status with USGS pending -> the address without a route opens Setup, marked in the navigation; on a phone Setup keeps its place on the bar and Home stays under More; finishing Setup's last required step later leaves the admin on Setup
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c follow-up (DECISIONS-for-review.md §34i; owner: ops-screens). e2e/admin/specs/ops/ops.spec.ts; the last step's case: packages/admin/test/app/navigation.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A photo published and renamed in the admin shows in the viewer
scenarios.asserts: the photo editor: Published on, Save -> the build publishes the photo; a new Romanian title, Save -> the manifest in the public bucket carries it -> the viewer served that manifest opens the photo's link with the new title
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §12.3 "Admin to viewer"; owner: integrator). e2e/admin/specs/flows/publish.spec.ts

scenarios.title: A revert from History reaches the viewer
scenarios.asserts: History of the photo: the rename's version -> Revert, asked first -> history.revert brings the old title back -> the next manifest carries it -> the viewer shows the old title
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §12.3 "Admin to viewer"; owner: integrator). e2e/admin/specs/flows/publish.spec.ts

scenarios.title: A place added from its list of positions shows in the viewer
scenarios.asserts: Add place, Point, Add at centre, the latitude and longitude typed, the Romanian title, Save -> published on save -> the manifest lists the point -> the viewer draws it in its category and opens its details on a click
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §12.3 "Admin to viewer"; owner: integrator). e2e/admin/specs/flows/publish.spec.ts

scenarios.title: A layer's defaults and image adjustments reach the viewer
scenarios.asserts: the layer editor: Shown at start on, Default opacity 60 % and saturation -100 % from the keyboard, Save -> the document and the manifest carry opacity 0.6, defaultVisible and adjustments {saturation: -1} -> the viewer starts with the layer shown, its slider at 60 %, and a pixel probe reads the tile's colour desaturated at 60 % over the basemap
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §12.3 "Admin to viewer"; owner: integrator). e2e/admin/specs/flows/publish.spec.ts

scenarios.title: An unpublished photo leaves the viewer
scenarios.asserts: Published off, Save -> the next manifest no longer lists the photo -> the viewer's link to it says the photo does not exist and opens nothing
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §12.3 "Admin to viewer"; owner: integrator). e2e/admin/specs/flows/publish.spec.ts

scenarios.title: A publish within the month's compute units is counted
scenarios.asserts: a publish that fits -> its estimate reserved in usage/mapbox-YYYY-MM, counted when the MTS job succeeds (the reservation released), publishes + 1
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/publish.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: A publish over the month's compute units waits with three choices
scenarios.asserts: the estimate exceeds what is left -> the approval card shows the estimate, what is left and three choices (free Studio upload, next month, pay about $X); nothing reaches Mapbox
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/publish.spec.ts. A version the policy approved and the guard stopped shows the choices (CR-M3-33).

scenarios.title: The free Studio upload replaces the MTS publish
scenarios.asserts: Free: Studio -> download the Studio file, open Mapbox Studio, 'I uploaded it' -> the tileset found by its name becomes the layer's source; studioUploads + 1
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/publish.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A deferred publish runs next month
scenarios.asserts: Defer -> the version waits until the 1st of next month (UTC); imagery.tick publishes it then, after checking the guard again
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/approve.test.ts and functions/test/imagery/tick.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: The 25th tileset needs the owner
scenarios.asserts: 24 published tilesets -> apiError.imagery.tilesetLimit and no Pay choice
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/publish.test.ts and functions/test/imagery/approve.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: Two publishes never share the same remaining units
scenarios.asserts: two approvals at once whose estimates fit only one -> the second waits with the choices (the reservations are one transaction)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/publish.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: A redelivered or recovered start never publishes twice
scenarios.asserts: a second start of a publish with its MTS job polls it; one whose answer was lost follows the job Mapbox lists instead of publishing again; the tick queues a stale job once (stale-<ms>), not every five minutes
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: A publish that keeps failing stops at its attempts
scenarios.asserts: after PUBLISH_MAX_ATTEMPTS starts the job fails apiError.imagery.attemptsExhausted and frees its reservation, and imagery.retry refuses it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: Two first publishes never both take the last tileset place
scenarios.asserts: the reservation of a first publish, read in the guard's transaction, and a deleted layer's tileset waiting for its deletion count against the cap
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: A file too large for Mapbox goes back to the admin with the free Studio way
scenarios.asserts: a 413 on the source upload sets the version approved with the guard's verdict too-large, frees the reservation and uploads nothing more; only Studio may be chosen; without a Studio copy the job fails
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: The layer's own tileset, or one older than the choice, is not a Studio upload
scenarios.asserts: I uploaded it answers apiError.imagery.studioNotFound for the layer's MTS tileset and for a tileset created before the choice; a newer one is linked
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: A budget pause shows the spend and Resume processing turns the guard green

scenarios.title: A queued job produces a draft layer within tolerance
scenarios.asserts: a queued usgs-import -> the pipeline (fake M2M serving the synthetic tgz, fake STAC with a Sentinel-2 COG, fake Overpass) runs fetch to register -> the version awaits approval with a checkpoint RMSE within tolerance of the known transform, a valid 8-bit COG with overviews, the preview and the Studio file; every step done
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_import_job.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: The real pipeline imports a free scene from the admin, and the viewer shows the published layer
scenarios.asserts: Import on the 1966 frame's card -> python -m hcm_pipeline run (the quality image's pipeline venv) against the emulators and the mock USGS, STAC and Overpass answering a synthetic scene -> every step done, automatic points, checkpoint RMSE under the city's 15 m -> approved by the policy and published -> the manifest lists it, the viewer paints its tiles and its opacity slider fades them
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (the integrator, 2026-10-24; CR-M3-16, CR-M3-19). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/pipeline.spec.ts; the scene is pipeline/tests/synthetic/scenes.py, generated into the test's folder. Per push at admin-l1440-ro only (it does not depend on the window class).

scenarios.title: A corrupt archive fails the job with a clear error
scenarios.asserts: a corrupt archive -> the job failed at extract with apiError.imagery.archiveCorrupt; the delivery deleted so a retry downloads it again
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_import_job.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: Missing reference coverage fails the job with a clear error
scenarios.asserts: no Sentinel-2 item over the window -> the job failed at locate (the corner guess scores against Sentinel-2) with apiError.imagery.referenceUnavailable; Overpass down after three tries -> failed at reference with the same code
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_import_job.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: An MTS job failure is retried
scenarios.asserts: the MTS job fails with an internal error -> published again once; a recipe error -> the job failed with apiError.imagery.mtsRefused, the reservation released, the layer's tiles unchanged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/publish.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23). The publish runs in functions since M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §7).

scenarios.title: SIGTERM cancels the job and cleans up
scenarios.asserts: SIGTERM while cancel is requested -> the job cancelled, the job's work/ objects and the local temp files removed, exit 0
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_import_resume.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: SIGTERM without a cancel keeps the work for a resume
scenarios.asserts: SIGTERM during fetch -> the checkpoint (offset, hash state) kept, the lease released, the job queued again; the resume skips the finished steps and continues the download where it stopped
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_import_resume.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: USGS maintenance makes the pipeline wait and exit
scenarios.asserts: the HTML 503 from M2M -> waiting_usgs with retryAt 30 minutes later (then doubling, at most 12 hours), exit 0, no failure
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_import_resume.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: An expired download address is retrieved again, never logged
scenarios.asserts: the download address answers 403 -> download-retrieve again and the stream resumes; the signed address appears in no log line and no Firestore field
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_import_resume.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A short delivery is discarded
scenarios.asserts: the delivered size differs from download-options -> apiError.imagery.downloadIncomplete, the object discarded, fetched again on the next attempt
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_import_resume.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A second execution of a leased job does nothing
scenarios.asserts: a second execution while the lease is held -> exit 0 without touching the job
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_import_job.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A georeferenced upload is warped with its own georeference
scenarios.asserts: geotiff-import of a georeferenced GeoTIFF -> inspect finds its georeference (embedded) -> warp, export, register; the version awaits approval
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_upload_job.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A plain TIFF waits for points
scenarios.asserts: geotiff-import of a TIFF without georeference -> the scan, its preview and the reference written; the job awaiting_gcps, the version needs_gcps
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_upload_job.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A GDAL failure on the pipeline's own files is a processing failure; only an unreadable upload asks for the file again
scenarios.asserts: a corrupt USGS segment fails apiError.imagery.processingFailed; an upload GDAL cannot read fails apiError.imagery.unreadableRaster
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: Re-georeferencing with manual GCPs produces a new version
scenarios.asserts: regeoref with the admin's points -> a new version whose residuals and checkpoint RMSE are those of the exact golden cases (0 within 0.01 m, pipeline/tests/contracts/georef-cases.json), awaiting approval; the base version's scan reused unchanged, no USGS call
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_regeoref_job.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A degenerate GCP set fails with an error
scenarios.asserts: collinear or coincident pairs -> the job failed at georef with apiError.imagery.degenerateGcps (imagery.saveGcps refuses them first)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_regeoref_job.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A crop ring cuts the layer
scenarios.asserts: regeoref with a crop ring -> gdalwarp -cutline; the COG is transparent (nodata) outside the ring
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_regeoref_job.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A synthetic Corona frame: confident pairs fit, the rest are suggestions
scenarios.asserts: georef.gcps all at or above AUTO_GCP_MIN_CONFIDENCE with score and residualM; a fifth held out as checkpoints gives checkpointRmseM within the truth's tolerance; suggestions between AUTO_GCP_SUGGEST_MIN and the confidence, at most MAX_SUGGESTIONS, best first, shaped as version.needs-gcps.suggestions.json; the same seed gives the same pairs
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §2.1–§2.4; owner: autogcp). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_autogcp.py against the loopback fakes and the synthetic world through an exact affine map (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: Too few SIFT keypoints: ORB matches instead
scenarios.asserts: a faded synthetic scan (contrast 5 %) where SIFT finds fewer than the minimum keypoints -> suggestions.method orb and the frame still placed within the truth's tolerance (checkpoint RMSE and the fit against the exact map)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §2.1; owner: autogcp). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_autogcp.py against the loopback fakes and the synthetic world through an exact affine map (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A cloudy Sentinel-2 window: OpenStreetMap's lines still place the frame
scenarios.asserts: the Sentinel-2 reference under cloud from edge to edge -> channels include osm, tiles matched on the distance field, the frame placed within the truth's tolerance by OpenStreetMap's lines
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §2.1; owner: autogcp). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_autogcp.py against the loopback fakes and the synthetic world through an exact affine map (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: Fewer than six confident pairs: the version waits with every candidate suggested
scenarios.asserts: the job awaiting_gcps, the version needs_gcps with apiError.imagery.noMatch {pairs} and suggestions holding every candidate at or above AUTO_GCP_SUGGEST_MIN, confident ones included; nothing warped
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §2.3; owner: autogcp). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_autogcp.py against the loopback fakes and the synthetic world through an exact affine map (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: Enough confident pairs in a line wait with their own reason
scenarios.asserts: eight confident pairs along one road give no fit -> the job awaiting_gcps, the version needs_gcps with apiError.imagery.noSpread {pairs: 8} (not noMatch's too few) and every candidate suggested; the georeferencer's panel says the pairs lie almost in a line

scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §2.3; owner: autogcp). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_autogcp.py against the loopback fakes and the synthetic world through an exact affine map (pipeline-pytest).
